decisions.decision: Autonomous Browser QA becomes a permanent part of MatchPilot governance. For every PR that changes the site, the frontend, the APIs the browser reads or visible behaviour, unit tests, integration tests, a build, green CI without browser evidence or a code-only AI review are not enough: a Browser QA Gate on a really running environment is mandatory (WEB CHANGE + NO VERIFIED BROWSER QA = MERGE BLOCKED). An unexecuted check is never PASS. Exemptions only through the verifiable automatic impact classification. Level A deterministic (Playwright, real Chromium, isolated QA database, fixtures, desktop and mobile, interactions, screenshots, traces, console/JS/HTTP errors, basic accessibility, repeatable regressions, locally and in CI without Render); level B exploratory AI agent, which does not replace level A and stays NOT VERIFIED when not available or authorized. Every confirmed bug yields a regression test where possible. Severity P0 security/integrity/gravely wrong, P1 main function unusable or substantially wrong result, P2 limited defect with workaround, P3 visual/minor; confirmed open P0/P1 block the gate, P2/P3 may be deferred only with recorded reason, impact and follow-up. Each gate produces a verifiable report (commit SHA, environment and browser, software version, dataset, journeys, counts, JS and HTTP errors, screenshots, traces, findings, limitations, verdict) kept as CI artifact, without secrets. An automatic control blocks certification of a web PR without valid Browser QA evidence for the actual head, resistant to missing or stale artifacts, unexplained skips, incomplete reports, PASS without execution, later changes and arbitrary exemptions; branch protection and required checks must be verified; changing repository protections needs owner authorization. No Render deploy or reactivation, no production Neon writes or migrations, no new paid services, no real money or exchange execution, no destructive data changes, no unprotected public QA environments. PR #163 is not invalidated; the rule applies to web changes after its verified activation. Phases: A audit (read-only), B deterministic gate, C exploratory agent, D end-to-end certification; HARD CERTIFIED only when environment, interactions, defect detection, reproducibility, re-check of fixes, refusal of invalid evidence, non-bypassability and the separately tested exploratory agent are all demonstrated.

The browser shows missing information as such, never invented, silently replaced by zero or misleading. Strategy profitability is not a software quality criterion.

decisions.decision: Permanent product rule for every present and future page, component, mobile and desktop screen and feature of the ordinary MatchPilot interface: it never shows raw text, developer text, technical descriptions, internal identifiers, table names, dataset paths, pipeline states, API keys, diagnostic or debug messages or implementation jargon, nor superfluous explanatory text under titles, cards, tables or controls; MatchPilot looks and behaves like a professional football analysis and trading platform. Examples to remove from the Daily Board: 'Le partite di un giorno nei dati salvati…', 'Orari come forniti dal fornitore', 'ora del fornitore', 'Fase: Storico · dataset: spain/laliga/2024-2025', 'Stato risultato' when redundant; they are examples of a systemic problem, not the whole of it. Sports and financial information (1X2, Over/Under, both teams to score, results, xG) is shown with professional, readable, compact and consistent components; missing data is shown discreetly, never invented, keeping absent distinct from zero; information needed to understand the data (time, origin, state when relevant) stays accessible with a non-technical presentation; diagnostics, technical provenance, identifiers and metadata stay in the systems and in dedicated technical views; mobile and desktop meet the same standard; no fictitious features, simulated data or unverified content to improve the look. A global audit classifies every text of every page and component (useful to the user, redundant, technical internal, necessary to redesign visually) in a matrix with current text, position, proposed action and verification test; the work is not complete after the Daily Board alone. The rule is recorded in the canonical product registers and the roadmap; the global cleanup is planned inside V-B, in small verifiable PRs, without interrupting the PR sequence. Every such PR: desktop and mobile tests in a real browser, before/after screenshots, a check that no real data is lost, a check of technical strings and regressions, Gate A/B, CI and independent review, no merge with blocking findings. Acceptance: no user screen looks like a debug page, a technical report or a raw prototype. No Render or Neon change, no deploy, no cost without authorization.
decisions.scope: the whole MatchPilot interface, present and future; V-B and every later web PR

decisions.decision: Controlled autonomous execution of the roadmap from the baseline V-B1 (#169, squash 1a0d1b3), one implementation PR at a time: V-B2 (home Oggi on the Daily Board, technical area Dati with Dashboard, Fornitori dati, API and Copertura, professional desktop and mobile navigation, complete Dashboard cleanup per the UI inventory, plain labels, a discreet update indicator only from real timestamps, compatible routes and links, the V-B1 merged checkpoint), V-B3 (mockup identity: charcoal palette and amber #FFB547, official logo, authorized local fonts, components, spacing, hover/focus/loading/error states, desktop/mobile coherence, no new features), V-B4 (compact Daily Board, 1-X-2 and supported markets, results and xG, responsive tables, match navigation, N/D, errors and empty states; no simulated values or browser calculations), QA-V (desktop/mobile baselines, reproducible comparisons, automatic regression checks, forbidden technical strings, SHA-256 manifest, permanent evidence, CI blocking only real regressions, baselines never updated automatically), then R-07a resumed from the saved checkpoint and WIP, then the next activity reconciled with #3, #97 and #104. Each PR: baseline and dependencies, Gate A, implementation, RED-GREEN, Browser QA desktop/mobile, regression and governance, evidence and checkpoint, PR, independent review, fixes, CI and the required check CI gate, Gate B, protected merge only when authorized and compliant, verification on main, roadmap and registers, then the next PR without waiting. Event notifications: the agent notifies itself (scheduled self check-ins into its own session and the PR record), never notifications the owner has to accept; one per significant state change, with PR, phase, head SHA, real gate state, evidence links, next action and any owner decision required; nothing is declared active unless configured and tested; no H24 autonomy is claimed without a real scheduler, and no paid one is created. Checkpoints keep the work resumable after interruptions. Stop only for substantial functional or economic decisions, unresolvable conflicts, unauthorized costs, deploy or production changes, data migrations or deletions, real money, merges reserved to the owner, unmitigable security risks, or a mandatory gate without reliable evidence. No Render deploy, no production Neon change, no new spend, no LIVE trading, no invented data, no loss of real data, no bypass of CI, Gate A/B or independent review, no arbitrary change to the approved mockup, no automatic baseline update, no artificial closing of findings.

decisions.decision: Controlled operational autonomy, one implementation PR at a time, towards a complete, working, tested and certifiable MatchPilot built first on the historical FutPythonTrader and TotalCorner archives. Order: P0 reconcile V-B4 (merge, main SHA, CI and required checks, independent review, Gate B, Browser QA evidence and checksums, post-merge checkpoint, registry state, correcting any divergence only with GitHub evidence); P1 complete the visual certification QA-V (desktop and mobile, navigation, Daily Board, search, Dati, empty/loading/error/partial states, responsive, screenshot regression, technical-text regression, consistency with the approved mockup; screenshots, reports, manifest and SHA-256 kept; reproducible and in CI where planned); P2 Match Center R-07a from the saved checkpoint and WIP, the pre-match part of its contract only (header, available team information, pre-match statistics and indicators, form, home/away, xG and other available metrics, historical odds and markets, authorized filters, provenance, absent or incomplete data), Browser QA, integration tests and verification on really available data, never declaring all 20 cards done; P3 the R-02 archive block without bypassing it (certified #40 package: files, manifest and SHA-256, integrity and portability, DuckDB, distinct matches versus raw records and snapshots, competitions and seasons, markets and odds, pre-match and live timestamps and snapshots, per-field coverage, provider links, unrecoverable gaps; no new provider download, no production Neon write; if not materializable, document the cause, keep the block and continue only with independent work). A permanent certifiability matrix maps feature, requirement, inputs, data really present, executable tests, evidence and status, with at least REAL DATA PASS, DETERMINISTIC TEST PASS, PARTIAL COVERAGE, NOT VERIFIED, BLOCKED, FAIL; a fixture test is never equivalent to a real-archive test, nor a historical replay to a certified H24 realtime collector; no invented data. Then reconcile #3, #97, #104, #12, #20, #24, #25, #28, #29, #30, #34, #94, #96, #98, #99, #100, #102 and proceed with the next really unblocked PR; the 82 historical PRs are not the remaining count. Every PR passes Gate A, real implementation, RED-GREEN where applicable, unit and integration tests, Browser QA for web changes, real historical data tests when available, temporal anti-leakage checks, governance and security checks, independent review D2, Gate B, authorized merge and post-merge verification. Notifications only through channels that really exist (scheduler, GitHub triggers, webhooks, resume), with PR, SHA, test result, evidence links and next action, never repetitive; without a persistent system no H24 autonomy is claimed and a zero-cost proposal is prepared, asking approval only for new authorizations, credentials or costs. Real-money exchange betting stays out of scope. Without new authorization: no Render deploy, no production Neon writes, no new spend or purchases, no destructive archive operations, no change to economic or functional contracts, no real-money trading, no branch-protection bypass, no merges reserved to the owner, no certification without evidence.

decisions.decision: The operational priority is now to build, integrate, test and progressively certify the real features of MatchPilot, first on the historical FutPythonTrader and TotalCorner archives; the functional roadmap and every earlier owner decision stay confirmed. No reduction of security controls or certification requirements, and no new governance layers, redundant registers or purely documentary work without a demonstrable technical benefit: documentation proves the software works, it does not replace it. Order: complete PR #175 and reconcile QA-V; Match Center R-07a (opening a match, teams and competition, available pre-match data, historical statistics, odds and markets really present, provenance, N/D, planned filters, desktop and mobile, navigation from Daily Board and search, PIT integrity; no invented metric; never all 20 cards when the PR covers the first batch); prepare the R-02 unblock without base64 downloads through the AI context (authorized Drive client, streaming to the filesystem, an authorized VPS when available, copies already on persistent storage, tools that never expose the bytes in the context; no paid resource, no public archive, no token in repository, logs or prompts), then the archive checks (parts and sizes, rebuild, manifest and SHA-256, independent readback, DuckDB integrity, distinct matches versus records versus snapshots, coverage per provider, market, competition and season, timestamps and post-kickoff contamination, read-only access, a portability and usability verdict), keeping R-02 BLOCKED with the exact unblocking action if access stays impossible, without stopping independent work; the P0 data requirements; Math Core and Indicator Library (definition, inputs and their real availability, output and unit, version, missing data, PIT policy, deterministic and historical tests, API, presentation), Trading Tools #94 without unauthorized approximations and without duplicated formulas; Strategy Lab and backtest (indicator, condition, composition, versioned strategy, historical sample, matching, simulated outcomes, money management and commission, P/L, ROI, drawdown, reproducibility; no future data, no odds before their valid timestamp, explicit limits when quotes or observations are missing, no promise of profit); money management, ledger and replay in dependency order, with tests on monetary precision, stake and liability, commission, exposure, virtual balance, simulated orders, settlement, simulated hedge and cashout, chronological replay, restart and state rebuild, no double booking, concurrency and reproducibility, keeping simulated results, observed history and real provider data separate; then a first end-to-end proof archive → real match → Match Center → indicator → strategy → backtest → verifiable result on at least one real match of the certified archive once accessible, with deterministic fixtures clearly identified until then. Essential governance stays: Gate A, RED-GREEN where applicable, unit and integration tests, Browser QA for web changes, PIT and provenance, independent review, Gate B, CI, one implementation PR at a time, reproducible checkpoints, merges under existing authorizations; no new gates or registers without demonstrated technical need; master issues never closed automatically; ratified owner decisions unchanged; a merged PR is not global product certification. Notify only real blocks, new functional decisions, new costs, missing permissions, PRs needing mandatory approval, critical defects and important phase completions, through channels really available; no H24 claim without a verified persistent runner. Progress is reported as feature, code and SHA, tests, data (real, fixture or unavailable), certification scope and verdict, PR, blockers and next step, measured in working features, satisfied requirements and passed tests rather than documents or PRs. No implicit authorization for new spend, VPS purchase, Render reactivation, production Neon writes, collector reactivation, new provider subscriptions, destructive archive changes, real-money trading, public deploy, CI or branch-protection bypass, or merges needing owner consent.

decisions.decision: Prepare and introduce, through a small dedicated PR, a manual approval gate before every VPS deploy: a merge to main is not an authorization to deploy. The deploy job on the matchpilot-vps runner waits for the owner's approval of that run (GitHub environment vps-production with the owner as required reviewer), fails closed when the environment is missing or misconfigured, binds the approval to the run and its SHA, and keeps the existing SHA/main/runner checks, secrets and rollback. Re-run, workflow_dispatch and other triggers must not bypass it; the gate is PASS only once the approval is shown to be really mandatory. This GO covers the preparation only: the merge and the activation need a separate owner GO; one implementation PR at a time; no merge or deploy of #178, no change to credentials, runner, database or historical data, no spending.
